name: Resinpoint Stylus
description: A fine-point writing tool of carved Silverbark Ash with a Resinheart-cured tip, used with stain, soot-resin, or plant dye instead of the standard pen-and-ink setup of the realm. The pigment well runs through with regular fieldwork; refills are common in any apothecary or general goods market across the Feywood.
narrative_effects: Supports writing, sketching, and route-marking with elven stain and resin pigments.
Quieter and more travel-resilient than a realm pen-and-ink kit; no spillable ink bottle to manage.
Pairs with a Barkleaf Journal as the standard elven field-recordkeeping kit.
